subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2723
title: Requires the Department of Human Services to adopt rules requiring licensed long term care facilities, outpatient renal dialysis facilities and residential facilities to acquire and maintain backup power sources to be used during power outages.
headline: HB 2723 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2723 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
